headings.strategy: Bold, clean, tight tracking for cinematic authority.

body.strategy: Highly legible, neutral, perfect for data-dense interfaces.

mono.strategy: Used strictly for data points, KPI numbers, dates, and chart axes to provide a technical, production-ready feel.

rules: No generic fonts for headings. Use Manrope.
Data metrics and numeric KPIs MUST use JetBrains Mono.
Overlines and small labels MUST be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.1em]).

colors.strategy: Cinematic Swiss & High-Contrast. Harmonious and professional.
colors.variables_structure: Define these exactly in index.css as requested.
usage: Map Tailwind config to these exact CSS variables.
Use var(--bg) for the app background.
Use var(--panel) for cards and main surfaces.
Use var(--border) for 1px solid borders on cards/panels.
Never use pure black or pure white in dark mode.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Dashboard Cards: Flat background (bg-panel), 1px subtle border (border-border), max 8px border-radius.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use only for sticky headers or dropdowns: backdrop-blur-xl bg-panel/80. No completely transparent backgrounds.

shadows.light: shadow-sm on panels, shadow-md on hover for interactive cards.
shadows.dark: Avoid heavy shadows in dark mode; rely on 1px borders to define edges.

types: Shot-status distribution: Donut chart (PieChart with innerRadius).
Project progress: Horizontal bar charts (BarChart with layout='vertical').
Weekly KPIs: Sparklines (tiny LineChart or BarChart) inside Stat Cards.
Weekly versions/approved/returned: Stacked or grouped BarChart.
Staffing load: AreaChart or composed chart.
charts.styling: Use CSS variables var(--chart-1) etc. for fill/stroke. Remove default CartesianGrid or make it highly transparent. Use JetBrains Mono for axes.

components.ui_components: Use shadcn/ui. Ensure Card components are flat with borders. Implement a Theme Toggle (Sun/Moon icon) in the top nav.

grids_layouts.dashboard: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding for panels (p-6). Use optical alignment.
grids_layouts.hierarchy: Top Nav (with Theme Toggle) -> Page Header (H1 + Actions) -> KPI Row (col-span-1 each) -> Main Charts (col-span-2 or 3) -> Side Lists (col-span-1 row-span-2).

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Subtle -translate-y-[2px] on card hover. Transition transform and colors.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup standard CSS variables in index.css based on the exact hex codes provided for BOTH :root (light) and .dark (dark). Do not use Tailwind's default slate/zinc for custom properties unless specified.
2. Implement a Theme Provider and Toggle in the Top Navigation to allow switching between Light and Dark mode.

3. Build the Dashboard using Recharts: implement a Donut chart for 'Shot-status', a horizontal bar chart for 'Project progress', and a composed/bar chart for 'Weekly versions'. Use the --chart-* variables for colors.
4. Apply the provided JetBrains Mono font for all numbers in charts and KPI cards. Apply Manrope for headings.
5. Ensure all Card components use 'bg-panel' and 'border-border'. Keep dark mode surfaces premium (no excessive shadow).
6. Build the 'Weekly Report' and 'Staffing calendar' sections using high-density grid layouts (MODE B).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
